title: Skill
description: JSON Schema for a skill instance: an invocable $\mathcal{P}$-morphism declaring its precondition (domain), postcondition (codomain), body, composes-chain, witness shape, closure-position, and operation-kind. Per skill.md:11–15, requires-precondition and requires-postcondition are the domain and codomain of the underlying morphism and are not optional — a skill that does not declare them is not a $\mathcal{P}$-morphism record.

name.description: Kebab-case slug identifier. For transformer-typed skills the slug is a gerund.

description.description: Two-sentence effect-and-trigger surface bounded by Claude Code's prompt discipline.

has-closure-position.description: Settlement-grade — one of the four closure-position values.

has-operation-kind.description: The cell-graph operation the skill's body composes. Orthogonal to closure-position.

has-body.description: Reference to the body — either a script path (scripts/<name>.mjs) or an inference-runtime body specification.

produces-witness-shape.description: Reference to the witness shape the invocation emits.

requires-precondition.description: Reference to the shape predicate the input must satisfy — either a kebab-case structure-slug or an https://561.group/...schema.json IRI resolving to a JSON Schema 2020-12 file. The morphism's domain.

requires-postcondition.description: Reference to the shape predicate the output must satisfy — either a kebab-case structure-slug or an https://561.group/...schema.json IRI resolving to a JSON Schema 2020-12 file. The morphism's codomain.

admissible-in-scope.description: Scopes within which the skill is invocable.

requires-power.description: Power records the invoking agent must hold.
